arguments.message: You can view your full invoice history in the Billing section. From the left‑hand menu go to **Settings → Billing → Invoices**. The page shows a table of all invoices (most recent at the top); the summary card at the top only displays the current month’s invoice. Each row links to a downloadable PDF. If a month is missing, it likely means no paid invoice was generated for that period (e.g., the month was fully covered by a credit).
